items.titleEn: Arteta on leadership, Raya and away days
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta has opened up on our long away run, David Raya and leadership within the squad before we head to Brighton
bodyEn: Our trip to Brighton will end a run of four away matches in two weeks as we look to maintain our perfect start to the season.

We've picked up victories over Napoli, Sunderland and Ipswich Town since our last home match against Chelsea. But whether we're in N5 or on the road, Mikel Arteta is keen for his team to impose the same style.
"That's one of the challenges of the schedule, and the team has responded so well," he said in his press conference.

"Playing with a dominance, it doesn't really matter if we play at home or away, we want to be the same team and we want to cause the same kind of problems to the opposition. We have managed to win the three games, and we've got the last one against a really tough opponent, as I said, against Brighton tomorrow, and we'll try to do the same.
"We've got a really tough opponent tomorrow, so we're going to have to really earn the right to win the game, but certainly that will be the mindset of the players and the team.
"I have huge respect for Fabian [Hurzeler], what he’s done and what Brighton have done as a club, it’s just remarkable. Tomorrow is going to be a beautiful game to watch, I’m sure."
One of the key reasons for our success on our travels has been David Raya. The stopper has been in superb form, thwarting Enzo Le Fee's penalty in our 2-0 success at the Stadium of Light.

Reflecting on his journey from loan spells in the National League to being a three-time Golden Glove winner, Mikel said: "That's a great story, I think for any kid as well, to look at trajectories and pathways, and how you can reach the highest level in football, and always maintaining that will, that motivation, and that enthusiasm that it can happen, and now football, especially internationally, is so connected that you never know, you might be playing a game, somebody scouts you, and you can end up in two or three years' time playing at the highest level, and David, I think it's his mentality.

"Obviously he has tremendous quality, but he has overcome a lot of difficulties, a lot of challenges, to reach to this point. When he reached this point, it wasn't easy in the beginning, he really had to dig in and prove himself, and with all the coaches, with Inaki especially, doing amazing work with him daily, and all his teammates, he has earned the right to be one of the best now."
Our win over Ipswich Town saw us end the game five teenagers on the pitch, including Max Dowman and Marli Salmon, who both started and shone at Portman Road.
That has given our more experienced players the chance to help guide our starlets during the game, something which Mikel is delighted to see.

"You cannot coach that, I think you have it or you don't, because it's a split of a second, it's just a very emotional reaction when you are in the middle of the game, and I absolutely love it, because we've all been there, and just encouraging the confidence that it gives to a 16-year-old to go again and deliver in the next action, it's huge."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈论领导力、拉亚与客场之旅
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔在对阵布莱顿赛前谈及客场连战、大卫·拉亚及球队领导力。
bodyZh: 客场对阵布莱顿将结束我们两周内的四场客场之旅，我们将力求延续本赛季的完美开局。
自从上一场主场对阵切尔西的比赛以来，我们已经先后击败了那不勒斯、桑德兰和伊普斯维奇。但无论是在主场还是在路上，米克尔·阿尔特塔都希望球队能够展现出同样的风格。
他在新闻发布会上表示：“这是赛程的挑战之一，而球队的反应非常出色。”
“我们要展现统治力，无论是在主场还是客场其实都一样，我们希望成为同一支球队，给对手制造同样的麻烦。我们已经赢下了前三场比赛，正如我所说，明天我们将对阵一个非常强硬的对手布莱顿，我们会努力做到最好。”
“明天我们将迎来一个非常难缠的对手，所以我们必须真正赢得比赛的胜利，但这绝对是球员和球队的心态。”
“我对法比安（许泽勒）以及布莱顿作为一家俱乐部所取得的成就充满敬意，这简直非凡。我确信明天将是一场精彩的比赛。”
我们在客场取得成功的一个关键原因是大卫·拉亚。这位门将在客场对阵光明球场的比赛中表现神勇，扑出了恩佐·勒费的点球，帮助我们2-0取胜。
回顾他从在全国联赛租借到三夺金手套奖的历程，米克尔说：“这是一个伟大的故事，我认为对于任何孩子来说，看到这样的轨迹和道路，以及你如何达到足球的最高水平，并始终保持那种意志、动力和热情，这是可能发生的。现在的足球，尤其是国际足联，联系如此紧密，你永远不知道，也许你正在踢一场比赛，有人在考察你，两三年后你就会达到最高水平，而大卫，我认为这归功于他的心态。”
“显然他拥有巨大的素质，但他克服了许多困难、许多挑战才走到这一步。当他走到这一步时，一开始并不容易，他必须真正咬紧牙关证明自己，在所有教练的帮助下，特别是伊ñ基每天对他的惊人工作，以及所有队友的支持，他现在赢得了成为最佳球员之一的权利。”
我们在对阵伊普斯维奇的比赛结束时场上有五名青少年球员，包括马克斯·多曼和马利·萨尔蒙，他们都在波特曼路首发出场并大放异彩。
这给了我们更有经验的球员在比赛中指导年轻球星的机会，米克尔对此感到非常高兴。
“你无法训练出这种能力，我认为你要么拥有它，要么没有，因为那是电光石火之间的事情，当你身处比赛之中时，这只是一种非常情绪化的反应，我绝对喜欢它，因为我们都经历过，只是去鼓励一个16岁的孩子重新振作并在下一次行动中发挥作用，这种自信是巨大的。”

items.titleEn: The 123-year club record we could equal at Brighton
items.summaryEn: Find out the piece of club history we could make against Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday
bodyEn: Our blistering start to the 2026/27 season saw us pick up a seventh straight victory after knocking Ipswich Town out of the Carabao Cup, putting us on the brink of a club record.

After maintaining a 100% record in our four Premier League outings, winning the Community Shield, beating Napoli in our Champions League opener and advancing in the League Cup at Portman Road, things have gone perfectly for us since we kicked off the season with a 3-0 win against Manchester City in Cardiff.
And should we beat Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday to keep our winning run intact going into the international break, we’ll match our longest winning start to a season, set 123 years ago.

Back in 1903/04, Woolwich Arsenal were playing in the Second Division and began the campaign on fire, winning all of their first eight matches, including a pair of 8-0 successes over Burton United and Leicester Fosse, and beating Manchester United 4-0.

That remains our best start to a season in all competitions, but Mikel Arteta’s class of 2026 could emulate those feats with a victory at the Amex Stadium. They have already matched our second-best effort, which came much more recently in 2004/05, when the Invincibles marched on by winning the first seven games of that campaign before a 2-2 draw against Bolton Wanderers in game eight.
Our best winning starts to a season (all comps)

Only in five other seasons have we won our first five league games, but Mikel is the only boss to have done it twice, having also started the 2022/23 season with a 100% record. The 1947/48 campaign is the only top-flight campaign where we reached six wins at the start of a league campaign, meaning we can also match that feat this weekend.
And when you take into account the five successive victories that took us to title glory last season, we're heading to the south coast this weekend on the back of nine straight Premier League wins.

That is our best winning stretch in the league since March 2004 when Arsene Wenger’s men also hit nine in a row. We've hit double figures only three times before; the first came back in November 1987 under George Graham when we won 10 First Division matches in succession. This stretch also included four League Cup victories, with the 14 successive wins marking our longest winning run across all competitions in our history.

We also hit 10 straight league victories between March and May 1998 as Wenger steered us to his first English title, however we still have some way to go to beat our club record of 14 successive league wins, which was achieved during the conclusion of the 2001/02 double-winning campaign, as well as the first few weeks of the following season.

items.titleZh: 我们在对阵布莱顿的比赛中可能追平123年的俱乐部纪录
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳若击败布莱顿，将追平123年前创下的赛季开局连胜纪录。
bodyZh: 我们在2026/27赛季开局状态火热，在卡拉宝杯淘汰伊普斯维奇后取得了七连胜，这让我们距离追平俱乐部纪录咫尺之遥。
在保持英超四战全胜、赢得社区盾杯、在欧冠首战击败那不勒斯并在波特曼路晋级联赛杯之后，自我们在加的夫以3-0击败曼城开启新赛季以来一切都完美无缺。
如果我们能在周六击败布莱顿并保持连胜进入国际比赛日，我们将追平123年前创下的赛季最长连胜开局纪录。
早在1903/04赛季，当时名为皇家阿森纳（Woolwich Arsenal）的球队在乙级联赛中开局势不可挡，赢得了前八场比赛的全部胜利，其中包括以两个8-0大胜伯顿联和莱斯特福斯，以及以4-0击败曼联。
这依然是我们各项赛事最佳的赛季开局，但米克尔·阿尔特塔麾下的2026届子弟兵有望在运通球场通过一场胜利复制这一壮举。他们已经追平了我们在2004/05赛季创造的队史第二佳战绩，当时不败之师在那个赛季的前七场比赛中全部获胜，直到第八场以2-2战平博尔顿流浪者。
我们各项赛事的最佳赛季开局连胜
只有在另外五个赛季中，我们赢得了前五场联赛，但米克尔是唯一一位两次达成此成就的主帅，他在2022/23赛季也曾取得过100%的开局全胜。1947/48赛季是我们唯一一次在顶级联赛开局取得六连胜的赛季，这意味着我们本周末也有望追平这一纪录。
考虑到上赛季助我们夺冠的五连胜，本周末我们前往南部海岸时正带着英超九连胜的势头。
这是我们自2004年3月温格麾下的球队取得九连胜以来，在联赛中最好的连胜势头。我们此前只有三次达成过两位数的连胜；第一次是在1987年11月乔治·格拉汉姆执教时期，当时我们连续赢下了10场甲级联赛。这一连胜势头还包括四场联赛杯胜利，14场连续胜利标志着我们俱乐部历史上各项赛事的的最长连胜纪录。
在温格引领我们夺得首个英格兰顶级联赛冠军的征程中，我们还在1998年3月至5月期间取得了联赛10连胜，不过要打破我们在2001/02双冠王赛季末期以及新赛季初期创造的14场联赛连胜的俱乐部纪录，我们还有很长的路要走。

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta's pre-Brighton presser
items.summaryEn: Hear what Mikel Arteta has to say before our trip to the south coast to face Brighton & Hove Albion at the Amex Stadium in the Premier League
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has spoken to the press ahead of our final match before the extended international break against Brighton & Hove Albion.
We're looking to continue our perfect start to the campaign, and the boss has been speaking about our winning start, taking on the Seagulls and much more.
Read every word below, with a video of the full press conference to follow.
on how Ben White is:Ben is all good, we have another training session this afternoon, so very positive about everybody.
on if he’s positive about Timber, Mosquera and Hincapie:Yes, we have another session; they are all willing to be part of it. We have another session to try to make sure they are fit.

on if he’s now able to influence referees by calling out mistakes:No, I think I’m here to try to give my opinion, to defend my club, to give the very best to our players. In order to do so, obviously you guys can ask some questions, and we need to respond in the most direct way, I think, and fair way. I will make mistakes sometimes but I will try to be as fair as possible.

on wanting officials to get decisions right:We discuss many topics in this room and they’re important, all of them. We have a space to talk, to give our opinions, to have discussions, to have personal conversations. It’s everybody’s duty to try to improve the game and that’s what we’re here for.
on if we’ve heard from Pro Ref:These are conversations that will remain private, as usual, and they have to be kept that way.

on if he’d like an apology regarding the penalty at Sunderland:It’s not about the apology; it’s just agreeing whether the decision should have been different or not. Maybe [Pro Ref] have a different opinion. Let's try to improve and move forward together.

on Fabian Hurzeler providing an apology after our last game at Brighton:That’s all done, that’s all in the past. I have huge respect for Fabian, what he’s done and what Brighton have done as a club, it’s just remarkable. Tomorrow is going to be a beautiful game to watch, I’m sure.

on the potential to go eight wins in a row in all competitions:We've got a really tough opponent tomorrow, so we're going to have to really earn the right to win the game, but certainly that will be the mindset of the players and the team.
on if he’s going to sign a new contract:I think we are all very much aligned; whenever the time is right, we'll get that done. There is nothing to be concerned about.

on signing a contract two years ago during the international break:I don't know if the timing will be the same or different, I think we both have the same ambition and the same will, so whenever we have time we'll get that resolved.

on if he’s happy with the new longer break:Let's see, it's something that we'll have to experience. As you've seen, different national teams, different managers have taken different approaches in terms of the numbers that they have put in the squad, so it's going to be really important to have good communication with them, so they understand where our players are, what we expect, what they expect as well, and work together. That's always the best way.

on the mentality of the team when they consistently have to impose themselves away from home: That's one of the challenges of the schedule, and the team has responded so well. Playing with dominance, it doesn't really matter if we play at home or away, we want to be the same team and we want to cause the same kind of problems to the opposition. We have managed to win the three games, and we've got the last one against a really tough opponent, as I said, against Brighton tomorrow, and we'll try to do the same.

on if the onus is on our leadership group to support younger players:You cannot coach that. I think you have it or you don't, because it's a split-second, a very emotional reaction when you are in the middle of the game, and I absolutely loved it, because we've all been there, and just encouraging the confidence that it gives to a 16-year-old to go again and deliver in the next action, it's huge. I think he has mentioned it already, and it's good to see that bond, that connection within the team to try to help each other.

on if Guimaraes is predominantly a left or right midfielder:He can play on the left, on the right, in the middle, he can rotate from there. He's such a dynamic, versatile player that he can deliver great moments in any position, and it will be more down to what we need on the day, the relationship we have with the other midfielders, and for sure what the opponent does as well.

on how Raya has come from the National League to become one of the best goalkeepers in the world: That's a great story, I think for any kid as well, to look at trajectories and pathways, and how you can reach the highest level in football, and always maintaining that will, that motivation, and that enthusiasm that it can happen. Football now, especially internationally, is so connected that you never know, you might be playing a game, somebody scouts you, and you can end up in two or three years' time playing at the highest level. David, I think it's his mentality. Obviously he has tremendous quality, but he has overcome a lot of difficulties, a lot of challenges, to reach this point. When he reached this point, it wasn't easy in the beginning; he really had to dig in and prove himself, and with all the coaches, with Inaki [Cana] especially, doing amazing work with him daily, and all his teammates, he has earned the right to be one of the best now.

on if he’s been Mikel’s best signing:I don’t know - he’s been a tremendous signing, there’s no question about that. Whether he’s been the best or not, it’s just an opinion, but it doesn’t matter, we are so happy to have him. He’s helped take the team and the club to a different level, and now we need to maintain that level.

on if this type of international break could be better for momentum:Let’s see how it pans out. I think every national team is different - some play in Europe and others travel the world for two and a half weeks, so we have to wait and see how it goes.

on if this team could be another Invincibles:We just have enough on the plate today to prepare for the game against a really good Brighton tomorrow. We know how tough that’s going to be to earn the right to win it, that’s it.

on if Gyokeres is struggling for confidence:No, obviously, especially in the Premier League he hasn’t played that many minutes, but last week in Napoli he played and had a good game. That’s about moments as well, we need to give him all the support and confidence that he needs because we know the player we have, the capacity he has to score goals and what he can give to the team.

on if the team are still adapting to him or if he’s adapting to them:I think the team are doing certain different things this season as well, so it’s a bit of both. But that’s not just for Viktor; it’s for everybody - it’s the constant evolution of the player and team. Our job, and especially my job, is to try to fit that in and find those connections and level of confidence for the player to give his best for the team.

on if a change in environment is good for him after his past exploits with Sweden:He scored a few goals [last time]. That’s what a striker needs, they need minutes and goals to boost their energy. We have a game tomorrow, and hopefully he can deliver then.

on investing in young players from around the world:It’s us as a club, we know we want to constantly maintain this level and have the pathway already in-house - which is obviously the best way to bring players from the academy or youth teams to us. We need to be one of the best in the world at recruiting in the country and abroad to maintain that level.

on when young players are tempted by moves away to other big clubs:It is challenging because there are a lot of parties there and the way the system is at the top, it’s not easy. There are certain moments in those years when there are gaps where those big decisions need to be made, and they have the choice to make that decision as well. Something is not only what we want to do, it’s what the player, agent or family wants to do at times as well. That’s not easy, but we’ll for sure try to keep the best talent in-house.

on if he’s been surprised by how well we’ve started the season:We know how complicated it is to win a football match at this level, so to win seven, it tells the story. After the World Cup especially, there were a lot of unknowns about how the players and the team were going to react. We didn't have any time with them to work together, but as I said, they won. I've seen their attitude, and what I was seeing, I was really impressed with. Then you have to put it down to performances and the element of luck as well to win football matches, and we are here and then we want to make another one for sure tomorrow.

on if Dowman is asking to start more matches:That's the best way to knock on the door - to do it on the pitch, not in the office. I think with that you're just left out of arguments when a player delivers constantly on the pitch every single day in training. That's the best way, that's the best signal for the manager, that's the best signal for his teammates as well that they will demand that player play and what Max did the other day amongst all the players as well that haven't played that many minutes, was really impressive.

on what Eze brings to the left wing:He's always played there in his career; that's where all his biggest moments in his career and the highlights have come, and I think it's a place that he feels very, very, very comfortable. He can occupy different spaces through them but that's the space that generally he has created big moments for previous clubs as well to win matches.
on how to decide if Eze or Tzolis should start:In form, in the opponent, in the relationship that we have within that unit, there are a lot of factors.

on the impression Konsa has made so far and his link-up with Gabriel:I heard some great things about Ezri before he joined, and when you have him daily, you just realise the magnitude of the player that we signed - not only the player but the person, the way he presents himself, the way he's able to connect with people immediately. We talk about Big Gabi, when you see those two in the corridors talking, the way they interact with each other, it seems like they've been here for a long, long, long time together. That is great because that's a partnership that, in my opinion, is extremely important on the field, and then his attributes, the quality that he delivers to the team are something that really makes us better.

on how Dowman is developing as a person by being around the first team:In a really great way as well. When you see how those players behave daily, you know the level of attention they put into any detail, the way they look after themselves, the standard that they set. If you become part of that environment, that's only going to raise your level. It's going to educate you in a way that becomes normal and then you will hit another level because then you will be able to add to that. That's where Max is at the moment.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会重点内容
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈客战布莱顿、球员伤情及球队近况。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔在对阵布莱顿的比赛前接受了媒体采访，这也是漫长国际比赛日前的最后一战。
我们希望延续本赛季完美的开局，主教练谈到了球队的连胜开局、对阵海鸥军团以及更多话题。
请阅读下方的全部内容，稍后将提供完整新闻发布会的视频。
关于本·怀特的身体情况：本一切都很好，我们今天下午还有另一堂训练课，所以对每个人都非常乐观。
关于他对廷贝尔、莫斯奎拉和因卡皮耶是否保持乐观：是的，我们还有一堂训练课；他们都愿意参与其中。我们还有另一堂训练课来确保他们完全康复。
关于他现在是否能通过指出裁判错误来施加影响：不，我认为我在这里是试图表达我的观点，捍卫我的俱乐部，为我们的球员做到最好。为了做到这一点，显然你们可以提出一些问题，我们需要以最直接、最公平的方式做出回应。我有时会犯错，但我会尽量保持公平。
关于希望裁判做出正确判罚：我们在房间里讨论了许多话题，它们都很重要。我们有一个空间来交谈、发表意见、进行讨论和进行个人对话。尽力改进比赛是每个人的责任，这也是我们来这里的目的。
关于我们是否听取了职业裁判公司的意见：这些对话将像往常一样保持私密，必须保持这种状态。
关于他是否希望就桑德兰比赛中的点球获得道歉：这不是道歉的问题；这只是就是否应该做出不同的判罚达成一致。也许[职业裁判公司]有不同的看法。让我们一起努力改进并向前迈进。
关于法比安·赫尔泽勒在我们上一次在布莱顿的比赛后道歉：这一切都结束了，都成了过去。我对法比安、他所做的一切以及布莱顿作为一个俱乐部的成就怀有极大的敬意，这简直是了不起的。我相信明天的比赛一定会非常精彩。
关于各项赛事取得八连胜的潜力：我们明天将面对一个非常强大的对手，所以我们要靠自己的努力赢得比赛，但这肯定是球员和全队的精神面貌。
关于他是否会签新合同：我认为我们大家的意见非常一致；无论什么时候时机成熟，我们都会完成它。没有什么需要担心的。
关于两年前在国际比赛日期间签约：我不知道时间安排是否会相同，我认为我们都有相同的雄心和意愿，所以无论什么时候我们有时间，我们都会解决这个问题。
关于他对新的更长假期的看法：让我们拭目以待，这是我们需要亲身体验的事情。正如你所看到的，不同的国家队、不同的主教练在阵容人数上采取了不同的方法，因此与他们保持良好的沟通非常重要，这样他们才能了解我们的球员在哪里，我们的期望是什么，他们的期望是什么，然后共同努力。这永远是最好的方式。
关于球队在客场不断需要展现统治力时的心态：这是赛程的挑战之一，球队的反应非常好。带着统治力踢球，我们在主场还是客场踢其实并不重要，我们想要成为同一支球队，我们想要给对手制造同样的问题。我们已经赢得了三场比赛，正如我所说，明天我们将对阵一个非常强大的布莱顿，我们将尽力做到同样的事情。
关于领导小组是否有责任支持年轻球员：这是无法通过教练教出来的。我认为你要么有这种特质，要么没有，因为这是比赛进行中电光石火间非常情绪化的反应，我绝对喜欢它，因为我们都经历过，这给一个16岁球员带来的信心是巨大的，能让他再次挺身而出并在下一次行动中发挥作用。我想他已经提到了这一点，很高兴看到球队内部这种凝聚力和联系，大家试图互相帮助。
关于吉马良斯主要是左中场还是右中场：他可以踢左路、右路、中路，他可以从这些位置进行轮换。他是一名充满活力、全能的球员，能够在任何位置奉献精彩表现，这更多取决于我们在当天的需求、我们与其他中场球员的默契，当然还有对手的行动。

关于拉亚如何从全国联赛一步步成长为世界最佳门将之一：这是一个伟大的故事，我认为对于任何孩子来说，也是如此，去看看职业生涯的轨迹和途径，以及你如何能够达到足球的最高水平，并始终保持那种意愿、动力和热情，坚信这一切会发生。现在的足球，尤其是国际赛场，联系如此紧密，以至于你永远不知道，你可能正在踢一场比赛，有人在考察你，两三年后你就会在最高水平的赛场上踢球。大卫，我认为是他的心态。显然他拥有极高的素质，但他克服了许多困难、许多挑战才走到这一步。当他到达这一步时，一开始并不容易；他真的必须咬紧牙关证明自己，在所有教练的帮助下，特别是伊纳基[卡纳]每天对他的惊人工作，以及他所有的队友，他赢得了现在成为最佳球员之一的权利。
关于他是否是米克尔最佳签约：我不知道——他绝对是一次极好的签约，毫无疑问。至于他是不是最好的，这只是一种意见，但这并不重要，我们非常高兴拥有他。他帮助球队和俱乐部达到了不同的水平，现在我们需要保持这个水平。
关于这种国际比赛日是否有助于保持势头：让我们看看结果如何。我认为每个国家队都不同——有些在欧洲比赛，而另一些则要在两周半的时间里环游世界，所以我们必须等待并观察情况。
关于这支球队能否成为另一个不败之师：我们今天有足够的事情要做，那就是为明天对阵一支非常出色的布莱顿的比赛做好准备。我们知道要赢得胜利会有多艰难，就是这样。
关于约克雷斯是否在为找回信心而挣扎：没有，显然，特别是在英超联赛中他没有踢那么多分钟，但上周在那不勒斯他踢了比赛并且表现不错。这也是关于时机的问题，我们需要给他所有的支持和信心，因为我们了解这名球员，他进球的能力以及他能为球队带来的贡献。
关于球队是否还在适应他，或者他是否在适应球队：我认为球队本赛季也在做一些不同的事情，所以两者兼有。但这不仅对维克托如此；对每个人都是如此——这是球员和球队的不断进化。我们的工作，尤其是我的工作，就是试图将其融入其中，并找到这些联系和信心水平，让球员为球队发挥出最佳水平。
关于环境的改变对他来说是否在经历瑞典的征程后是一件好事：他进了一些球[上次]。这就是前锋需要的，他们需要出场时间和进球来提升能量。我们明天有一场比赛，希望他能有出色的表现。
关于投资来自世界各地的年轻球员：作为一家俱乐部，我们知道我们想要不断保持这个水平，并在内部拥有现成的培养途径——这显然是将学院或青年队球员带到我们这里的最好方式。我们需要成为国内和国外招募工作世界上最好的俱乐部之一，以维持这一水平。
关于年轻球员受到其他大俱乐部转会诱惑时：这具有挑战性，因为有很多方参与其中，而且顶层的运作系统使得事情并不容易。在这些年里，有某些时刻会出现真空期，需要做出重大决定，他们也可以选择做出这个决定。有些事情不仅是我们想做什么，也是球员、经纪人或家庭有时想做什么。这并不容易，但我们肯定会努力把最好的人才留在队内。
关于他对我们本赛季的出色开局是否感到惊讶：我们知道在这个水平上赢一场足球比赛有多么复杂，所以能赢七场，就说明了问题。特别是世界杯之后，关于球员和球队将如何反应有很多未知数。我们没有时间和他们一起工作，但正如我所说，他们赢了。我看到了他们的态度，我所看到的让我印象深刻。然后你必须把这归结为场上的表现以及赢得足球比赛的运气成分，我们现在在这里，明天我们肯定想再赢一场。
关于道曼是否要求获得更多首发机会：这是敲门的最好方式——在球场上展现出来，而不是在办公室里。我认为当一名球员每天在训练中在球场上持续有出色表现时，你就无话可说了。那是最好的方式，是对主教练最好的信号，也是对队友最好的信号，队友们会要求这位球员上场，马克斯和其他没有踢太多分钟的球员那天所做的一切，真的令人印象深刻。
关于埃泽能为左翼带来什么：在他的职业生涯中他一直踢那个位置；那是他职业生涯中所有最伟大时刻和高光表现诞生的切入点，我认为这是一个让他感到非常、非常、非常舒适的位置。他可以通过这些位置占据不同的空间，但那是他通常为前俱乐部创造赢得比赛的重大时刻的空间。
关于如何决定让埃泽还是措利斯首发：状态、对手、我们与该战术单元内部的默契，有很多因素决定。

关于孔萨迄今为止留下的印象以及他与加布里埃尔的搭档：在埃兹里加盟之前我听到了一些关于他的极好评价，当你每天与他相处时，你就会意识到我们签下的这名球员的分量——不仅是球员，还有他的人品、他展现自己的方式、他能够立即与人沟通的方式。我们谈论大加比，当你看到这两个人在走廊里交谈，他们互动的方式，看起来他们好像已经在一起很长、很长、很长的时间了。这太棒了，因为在我看来，这是一个在球场上极其重要的搭档关系，然后他的属性、他为球队带来的品质确实让我们变得更好。
关于道曼作为一个人在跟随一线队期间是如何成长的：成长得非常好。当你看到这些球员每天的表现时，你就知道他们在任何细节上付出的注意力水平、他们照顾自己的方式、他们设定的标准。如果你成为那种环境的一部分，那只会提高你的水平。它会以一种变得正常的方式教育你，然后你将达到另一个水平，因为那时你将能够有所增益。这就是马克斯目前所处的阶段。

items.titleEn: Arteta's update on White, Timber and Mosquera
items.summaryEn: The boss discussed our defenders as well as balancing the minutes in a large squad
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has provided an update on the fitness of our first team defenders, and the boss had plenty of positive news to share on Friday morning at the Sobha Realty Training Centre.
He was first asked about the likelihood of Ben White being involved in our trip to his former club Brighton on Saturday, and Mikel feels the England defender should be ready to go.
"They are all good," the boss reported on our squad, "we have another training session this afternoon, so very positive about everybody."
As well as Ben, the boss said that Jurrien Timber, Cristhian Mosquera and Piero Hincapie are all progressing well and could be involved in Saturday's game.
"We have another session, they are all willing to be part of it to try to make sure they are fit."
With a large squad to choose from, the boss has been balancing new signings with our existing squad members, which has seen several players deployed in multiple positions.
Eberechi Eze started on the left against Ipswich Town on Tuesday night, and Mikel was impressed with what he saw.
"He's always played there in his career, that's where all his biggest moments in his career and the highlights of his career have come.

"I think it's a place that he feels very, very, very comfortable. He can occupy different spaces, but that's the space that generally he has created big moments for previous clubs as well to win matches."

Ebere will be one of several first team players heading off to join their national team after our trip to Brighton on Saturday, with a newly extended international break seeing our men's side out of action until October 10.
While this creates a significant change to the early-season schedule, the boss is keeping an open mind on how it will play out.
"Let's see how it pans out," he said, "I think every national team is different.
"Some play in Europe, and others travel the world for two-and-a-half weeks, so we have to wait and see how it goes."
items.author: Connor Booth
items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈本·怀特、廷贝尔和莫斯克拉的情况
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔更新了后防球员的身体状况。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔介绍了我们一线队后卫的身体状况，周五上午在索巴地产训练中心，这位主帅分享了许多积极的消息。
他首先被问及本·怀特周六随队前往其老东家布赖顿参赛的可能性，米克尔认为这位英格兰后卫应该已经准备好了。
主帅在谈到球队情况时表示：“他们都很好，今天下午我们还有一次训练课，所以大家的情况都非常积极。”
除了本·怀特，主帅表示尤里恩·廷贝尔、克里斯蒂安·莫斯克拉和皮耶罗·因卡皮耶目前都进展顺利，可能会参加周六的比赛。
“我们还有一次训练，他们都很乐意参与其中，以确保自己的身体状态。”
拥有庞大的阵容可供调配，主帅一直在平衡新援与现有阵容成员的出场时间，这使得几名球员被安排在多个位置上。
埃贝雷奇·埃泽在周二晚上对阵伊普斯维奇镇的比赛中首发出任左边路，米克尔对他的表现印象深刻。
“在他的职业生涯中他一直踢那个位置，他职业生涯中所有最伟大的时刻和高光时刻都是在那里诞生的。”
“我认为这是一个让他感到非常非常舒适的位置。他可以占据不同的空间，但通常那是他以前为俱乐部赢得比赛时创造重大时刻的空间。”
埃贝雷将是周六客场对阵布赖顿后离队参加国家队比赛的多名一线队球员之一，由于新延长了国际比赛日，我们的男足一线队将休战至10月10日。
虽然这给赛季初的赛程带来了重大变化，但主帅对接下来会发生什么保持着开放的心态。
他说：“让我们看看事情会如何发展，我认为每个国家队的情况都不同。”
“有些在欧洲踢球，而另一些则要花两周半的时间环游世界，所以我们只能拭目以待。”

items.titleEn: Five stars called up to England squad
items.summaryEn: Find out which Gunners have been selected by Thomas Tuchel for the Nations League
bodyEn: Declan Rice, Bukayo Saka, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Eberechi Eze and Ezri Konsa have been named in the England squad for the quartet for UEFA Nations League matches.

During the extended international break, the Three Lions will play four of their six Nations League matches, which sees them face off against Spain and Czechia at Wembley, as well as trips to Croatia and Czechia.
England's last match came at the World Cup against France where a host of our Gunners were on top form.
Declan Rice, captaining the Three Lions, netted the opener before Bukayo Saka scored a hat-trick in a 6-4 victory for England in the third-place playoff.
England's first match is at home to World Cup winners Spain on Saturday, September 26 at 7.45pm, they will then travel to Prague to face Czechia on Tuesday, September 29.
They continue on their travels, heading to Croatia on Saturday, October 3, before rounding off the international break with a home clash versus the Czechs on Tuesday, October 6.

items.titleZh: 五名球星入选英格兰代表队
items.summaryZh: 多位阿森纳球员获征召参加国家联赛。
bodyZh: 德克兰·赖斯、萨卡、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、埃贝雷奇·埃泽和埃兹里·孔萨入选了英格兰队参加欧洲国家联赛四场比赛的大名单。
在延长的国际比赛日期间，三狮军团将进行六场国家联赛中的四场，他们将在温布利球场对阵西班牙和捷克，还将客场挑战克罗地亚和捷克。
英格兰队的上一场比赛是在世界杯对阵法国队的比赛中，我们的多名枪手球员表现出色。
队长德克兰·赖斯率先破门，随后萨卡上演帽子戏法，帮助英格兰队在季军争夺战中以6比4取胜。
英格兰队的首场比赛将于9月26日星期六晚上7点45分主场迎战世界杯冠军西班牙队，随后他们将于9月29日星期二前往布拉格对阵捷克队。
他们将继续客场之旅，于10月3日星期六前往克罗地亚，并在10月6日星期二主场迎战捷克队，结束本次国际比赛日。

items.titleEn: Stream U21s trip to Birmingham this afternoon
items.summaryEn: David Horseman's side continue their PL2 campaign against the Blues
bodyEn: Our under-21s head to Birmingham City on Friday afternoon looking for our first win of the Premier League 2 season, and you can stream the action live on The Arsenal app and Arsenal.com.
Three games into the league campaign, we've recorded two points from draws with Crystal Palace and Brighton, before losing out to Chelsea last weekend.

But between our league games, we've recorded wins in the EFL Trophy over Leyton Orient, and the UEFA Youth League against Napoli, where several of our under-21s were involved in our under-19s victory.
Make sure to tune in on Friday afternoon as we travel to Birmingham, with the action getting underway from 12.55pm (UK) on The Arsenal app and on Arsenal.com.

items.titleEn: U21s preview: Birmingham City v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners will look to build on Tuesday's win over Leyton Orient
bodyEn: Our under-21s will be looking to build on an impressive 2-1 win over Leyton Orient as we return to Premier League 2 action against Birmingham City on Friday afternoon (1pm UK).
David Horseman's side came from behind to beat League One Orient in the EFL Trophy on Tuesday night, marking their first win of the season in style.
We'll now be looking to take that momentum into our league form, as we bid for our first PL2 win of 2026/27.
THE OPPOSITION
Birmingham City have been Premier League 2's entertainers so far this season, with five goals scored and seven conceded across their opening two fixtures.
City's opening game against Spurs proved to be a seesaw draw, in which Friday's opponents led 1-0 and 2-1 before scoring a late equaliser to draw 3-3.
It was a tougher first half for Birmingham a week later against Norwich, who raced into a 4-0 lead, before the Blues netted a couple of second-half goals to halve the deficit.
Zimbabwe international striker Menzi Mazwi, who has a senior cap for his country, has been the highlight of the campaign so far for Birmingham, netting three goals across City's first two PL2 games.
HOW TO WATCH

Supporters can tune into live coverage of the match on The Arsenal app and on Arsenal.com from 12.55pm (UK) on Friday afternoon, with live commentary available throughout. Updates will also be available on our Academy X account.
Post-match, don't miss highlights of all the key action from the contest.

items.titleZh: U21前瞻：伯明翰城对阵阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 小阿森纳将力争延续周二战胜莱顿东方的良好势头。
bodyZh: 周五下午（英国时间下午1点），我们的U21青年队将在英超2联赛中对阵伯明翰城，力争延续此前以2-1击败莱顿东方的出色表现。
周二晚上的EFL锦标赛中，戴维·霍斯曼（David Horseman）的球队在落后情况下逆转击败了英甲球队莱顿东方，取得了本赛季首场酣畅淋漓的胜利。
接下来，我们将把这股势头带到联赛中，全力争取2026/27赛季英超2联赛的首场胜利。
对手情况
在本赛季的英超2联赛中，伯明翰城堪称“进球大户”，在前两场比赛中他们打进5球，失7球。
伯明翰城对阵热刺的首场比赛跌宕起伏，他们在比赛中曾以1-0和2-1领先，随后在尾声阶段绝平，以3-3战平对手。
一周后对阵诺维奇的上半场对伯明翰来说则艰难得多，当时诺维奇取得了4-0的领先，随后蓝军在下半场连扳两球缩小了分差。
津巴布韦国脚前锋门齐·马兹维（Menzi Mazwi）是伯明翰本赛季迄今为止的亮点，他在前两场英超2联赛中已经攻入三球。
如何观看
球迷朋友们可以于周五下午英国时间12点55分起通过阿森纳官方App以及Arsenal.com观看本场比赛的直播，全场将提供实时解说。我们的青训官方X账号也会进行文字更新。
赛后，不要错过比赛中所有精彩瞬间的集锦。

items.titleEn: U18s preview: Norwich City v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners aim to continue their winning streak against the Canaries
bodyEn: Our young Gunners will look to make it three wins in a row when they travel to Norwich City on Saturday, September 19.
The match will take place at the Avant Training Centre, with kick-off scheduled for 12pm (UK time).
After a winless August, our under-18s have clicked into gear, securing back-to-back clean-sheet victories over Southampton and, most recently, Crystal Palace.
The 2-0 triumph in north London saw Emerson Nwaneri and Callan Hamill's strikes lift us into the top half of the U18 Premier League South.
THE OPPOSITION
The Canaries made an impressive winning start away at Chelsea, but three defeats followed before they claimed their next three points, with a 4-0 win over West Ham United last weekend.
The much-needed victory means the Norfolk side sit 12th with six points, one fewer than us.
In the U18 Premier League Cup, the East Anglian outfit are bottom of Group H after losing their opener 4-2 to West Bromwich Albion, with games against the Hammers and Middlesbrough still to come.
We last faced Norwich in February, losing 4-1 at the Sobha Realty Training Centre, with Brando Bailey-Joseph’s late goal proving only a consolation.
HOW TO FOLLOW
The action gets underway from 12pm (UK), with live updates available on our Academy X account and a full match report shortly after the final whistle.
Post-match, don't miss exclusive interviews with one of our academy coaches and young Gunners, as well as highlights of all the key action on The Arsenal app and Arsenal.com.

items.titleZh: U18前瞻：诺维奇城对阵阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 我们的年轻枪手渴望对阵金丝雀延续连胜势头。
bodyZh: 9月19日星期六，我们的年轻枪手客场挑战诺维奇城，力争取得各项赛事三连胜。
比赛将在阿旺特训练中心进行，开球时间定于英国时间中午12点。
在经历了一个没有胜绩的8月后，我们的U18梯队逐渐进入状态，先后零封战胜了南安普顿和水晶宫。
这场在北伦敦以2-0取胜的比赛中，埃默森·恩瓦内里和卡兰·哈米尔的进球帮助我们升至U18英超南部联赛的上半区。
对手情况
金丝雀在客场对阵切尔西时取得了令人印象深刻的开门红，随后遭遇三连败，直到上周末以4-0大胜西汉姆联才拿到下一个三分。
这场久旱逢甘霖的胜利意味着这支诺福克球队积6分排名第12位，比我们少一分。
在U18英超杯中，这支东安格利亚球队在首战以2-4不敌西布朗维奇后在H组垫底，他们接下来还要对阵西汉姆联和米德尔斯堡。
我们上一次对阵诺维奇是在2月，当时在索布哈·雷亚尔蒂训练中心以1-4告负，布兰多·贝利-约瑟夫的尾声进球仅能挽回一些颜面。
如何关注比赛
比赛将于英国时间中午12点开始，我们的学院官方X账号将提供实时更新，终场哨响后不久将发布完整的比赛报告。
赛后，不要错过我们的学院教练和年轻枪手之一的独家采访，以及阿森纳官方App和Arsenal.com上所有关键动作的精彩集锦。

bodyEn: Chelsea have not won this west London derby since Brentford’s first Premier League season. Each visit since October 2021’s 1-0 win, Ben Chilwell the scorer, has been a draw. This season has continued the divergence between the clubs’ respective approaches, Brentford’s solidity and continuity contrasting with Chelsea attempting their latest reboot. Kevin Schade, after two well-taken goals at Bournemouth, will fancy facing a defence not yet attuned to Xabi Alonso’s configurations. Only one team has won a Premier League title with a defensive trio: Chelsea’s last title team, in 2016-17 under Antonio Conte. Alonso’s attack has been rather more successful, presenting another challenge for Jannik Schuster. Replacing Nathan Collins, the 20-year-old central defender had a tough examination from Bournemouth’s Evanilson on his first Premier League start, emerging with credit. For Chelsea, João Pedro has three goals and three assists, but doubts surrounding his fitness could lead to Danny Welbeck’s first league start. John Brewin
Brentford v Chelsea, Friday 8pm (all times BST)

What happens when a very stoppable force meets an extremely movable object? We will be tuning into events at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Saturday to find out as 19th-placed Aston Villa arrive in north London. The teams have scored one goal between them in the league and are desperately hoping for a first Premier League win. The return of Pedro Porro is big for Roberto De Zerbi and that should bring the Archie Gray Experiment at right-back to a merciful end. No Premier League starting XI feels less settled than Spurs – most players look as if they are a mistake or two from being dropped – which has culminated in a side that seems governed by fear and continuously prefers to take the safe option. After coming off the bench against Everton and Liverpool in the past week, the injury-plagued James Maddison will be itching to start and take some sort of initiative for Tottenham. Michael Butler
Tottenham v Aston Villa, Saturday 3pm

When Fabian Hürzeler spoke about Brighton’s success being founded on them being “well structured” after their stirring comeback against Manchester United at Old Trafford on Wednesday, he could have been referring to Malick Yalcouyé. The 20-year-old Ivorian moved to the south coast in 2024 after spending just a few months with IFK Gothenburg in Sweden but had to wait until this season to make his senior debut for Brighton after being sent on loan to Sturm Graz in Austria and then Swansea last season. With Jack Hinshelwood sidelined by injury until after the international break, Yalcouyé has taken his chance in the No 10 role and already found the net twice in the Premier League as Brighton have made a brilliant start. Arsenal are up next for the division’s top scorers – who have 13 goals from their opening four matches – and Mikel Arteta should be wary of the threat posed by Yalcouyé and co as the champions prepare for a fourth away game in succession. Ed Aarons
Brighton v Arsenal, Saturday 3pm

Vitalii Mykolenko’s early-season improvement has gone largely unheralded – and it probably always will be among his detractors – but at a time when David Moyes needs experienced players to step up and defy the constraints of a small squad, the Everton left-back has produced. Having signed a new three-year contract in the summer, and seemingly bulked up, the Ukraine international has kept his critics quiet with several impressive displays for a defence that has four clean sheets in six matches. There remains a problematic lack of cover at left-back after the decision to loan Adam Aznou to Málaga for the season but Mykolenko, the better defender, has eased the concerns that surrounded his position before the new campaign. Ipswich’s new forward recruits, Emersonn and Zian Flemming, will test Everton’s solidity but Moyes’s side will have made an encouraging start should they sign off with a win before the extended international break. Andy Hunter
Everton v Ipswich, Saturday 3pm

As befits a lover of direct football, Matthias Jaissle likes to get straight to the point. On Thursday he was asked whether, in the light of Monday night’s 4-1 thrashing at Leeds and a raft of injuries, he was tempted to perhaps switch to a back five or modify his beloved “vertical” approach when Hull visit Tyneside on Saturday. The reply proved unequivocal. “No,” said a manager unafraid to answer questions with a single word. Instead Jaissle expects his young team to retain faith in a wider vision as Newcastle – who signed eight players aged 24 and under this summer – adapt to life after Bruno Guimarães, Sandro Tonali and Anthony Gordon. “It’s a brave journey the club is going on and I’m fully committed in that,” the German said. “If there’s one setback, we shouldn’t delete our journey or our vision. We’re fully committed. We’re fully aligned. We anticipated that something like that against Leeds would happen. It’s on us to respond. But while still believing. We don’t change.” Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Hull, Saturday 3pm

Many scoffed at the £45m that was paid for Liam Delap in the summer but Nottingham Forest feels like the perfect place for the striker to regain his form. Forest previously thrived with the now injured Chris Wood as their arrowhead and Delap is something of a younger regent for the New Zealander – powerful, instinctive and willing to bring others into play. During Saturday’s win at Villa, Morgan Gibbs-White and Delap looked as if they already have an understanding and both will be keen to capitalise against a Coventry side that have conceded eight goals in the past two games. After a nervy campaign last season, Forest feel back in the ascendancy and will have been delighted that plans to increase the City Ground’s capacity from 31,000 to 52,500, at an estimated cost of £790m, were approved by the local council on Wednesday. MB
Nottingham Forest v Coventry, Saturday 5.30pm

After watching Bournemouth make their European bow from afar in San Sebastián, a city Andoni Iraola knows inside out, the Basque head coach will return to his previous club on Sunday. Iraola – whose assistants Tommy Elphick and Shaun Cooper played for Bournemouth, the former captaining the club into the Premier League in 2015 – led the Dorset club into the Europa League by recording their best-ever finish, sixth. His body of work on the south coast earned him the Liverpool opportunity and a warm welcome is a guarantee. Despite the Cherries’ slow start under Iraola’s successor, Marco Rose, they will pose tricky opposition. The German spent a couple of hours in Iraola’s company before officially starting in June and both will be braced for an all-action contest. Eddie Howe failed to beat Bournemouth in the eight league games he managed against them with Newcastle and Iraola and his staff will expect a tough test. Ben Fisher
Bournemouth v Liverpool, Sunday 2pm

Dominic Calvert-Lewin will be a man on a mission against Crystal Palace at Elland Road on Saturday. Daniel Farke’s centre-forward hopes to become the first Leeds player to score in six consecutive home league games since Arthur Hydes back in 1932. Managers often, quite rightly, say players matter more than formations but, in Calvert-Lewin’s case, Farke’s switch to 3-5-2 late last November proved a road to Damascus moment. Until then he had struggled as the team’s lone striker but, once he was paired with Noah Okafor or Lukas Nmecha, the goals started to flow. Granted, Leeds sometimes play 3-4-3 or, occasionally, revert to a back four but Calvert-Lewin has emphasised the importance of attacking partnerships. After collecting eight points from their opening four games, Farke’s team have registered the best beginning to a top-tier campaign of any Leeds team since David O’Leary’s class of 2001-02. Will it continue at Palace’s expense? Is Hydes’ record under threat? Might 3-5-2 be the answer to ending more strikers’ goal droughts? Louise Taylor
Leeds v Crystal Palace, Sunday 2pm

Manchester City’s maximum 12 points from their first four Premier League games featured 1-0 wins (over Coventry and Manchester United), a 2-1 victory (Bournemouth), and a 4-1 success (Crystal Palace). Conceding only two goals while scoring eight is an impressive record that is only marginally bettered by the champions, Arsenal (one conceded, eight scored in their 12-point tally), and it seems a rosy augury that Enzo Maresca’s team will be genuine title contenders this season. Régis Le Bris, though, plots to halt City’s perfect start, and can draw on guiding Sunderland to a share of the points last season against the FA Cup holders, though that was at the Stadium of Light. In the corresponding fixture at the Etihad Stadium, City cruised to a 3-0 win. Jamie Jackson
Manchester City v Sunderland, Sunday 2pm

Oscar Bobb came off the bench against West Ham and fired Fulham into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup with a clinical late winner at the London Stadium on Tuesday night. It was a fine piece of individual play from the Norway winger but he needs to do it more often. The goal was Bobb’s first since joining Fulham last January and a player of his ability should be producing more of an end product. The 23-year-old is a clever dribbler and looked ready to establish himself at Manchester City before a serious injury curtailed his development. The talent is clear. Bobb had a good World Cup and should be full of confidence when Fulham, still seeking their first win in the league this season, host Manchester United. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Manchester United, Sunday 4.30pm

items.summaryZh: 英超联赛本周末迎来多场焦点战，阿森纳将客场挑战布莱顿。
bodyZh: 自布伦特福德升入英超以来，切尔西在西伦敦德比中还未尝胜绩。自2021年10月凭借奇尔韦尔的进球1-0取胜后，双方之后的每次交手均以平局收场。本赛季延续了两家俱乐部不同的建队思路，布伦特福德的稳固与延续性形成了鲜明对比，而切尔西则在尝试他们最新的一次重启。凯文·沙德在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中攻入两粒精彩进球，他很期待面对一支尚未适应哈维·阿隆索战术体系的防线。只有一支球队曾凭借三后卫阵型赢得英超冠军：那是安东尼奥·孔蒂率领的2016-17赛季切尔西。阿隆索的进攻则要成功得多，这也为雅尼克·舒斯特带来了另一项挑战。作为内森·柯的替代者，这位20岁的中后卫在个人英超首秀中经受住了伯恩茅斯埃瓦尼尔森的严峻考验，表现可圈可点。对切尔西而言，若昂·佩德罗已经贡献了3粒进球和3次助攻，但他的身体状况存疑，这可能会让丹尼·维尔贝克迎来本赛季的联赛首发。
布伦特福德对阵切尔西，周五晚上8点（所有时间均为英国夏令时）

当一支极易被攻破的球队遇到一支极其缺乏移动能力的队伍时会发生什么？周六我们将把目光投向托特纳姆热刺球场，寻找这个问题的答案，届时排名第19位的阿斯顿维拉将做客北伦敦。两支球队在联赛中总共只打进一球，目前都极其渴望取得他们的首场英超胜利。佩德罗·波罗的回归对罗伯托·德泽尔比来说意义重大，这应该能让阿奇·格雷在右后卫位置上的试验画上一个仁慈的句号。没有哪支英超球队的首发阵容显得比热刺更不稳定——大多数球员看起来只要犯一两个错误就会被弃用，这导致球队踢得畏首畏尾，总是倾向于选择稳妥的方式。在上周对阵埃弗顿和利物浦的比赛中替补登场后，饱受伤病困扰的詹姆斯·麦迪逊将渴望首发，为托特纳姆热刺带来一些进攻的主动性。
托特纳姆热刺对阵阿斯顿维拉，周六下午3点

当法比安·赫尔泽勒在周三于老特拉福德球场逆转战胜曼联后，谈到布莱顿的成功建立在球队“组织有序”的基础之上时，他所指的可能就是马利克·亚尔库耶。这位20岁的科特迪瓦人在2024年加盟布莱顿，此前他曾在瑞典的哥德堡效力短短几个月，但在上赛季被租借至奥地利的格拉茨风暴以及之后的斯旺西后，他直到本赛季才迎来一线队首秀。由于杰克·欣谢尔伍德因伤将缺阵至国际比赛日之后，亚尔库耶抓住了机会出任10号位，并在英超联赛中已经打入两球，帮助布莱顿取得了梦幻般的开局。作为联赛的领头羊，布莱顿在前四场比赛中打入13球，他们接下来将迎战阿森纳，在卫冕冠军准备迎来连续第四个客场比赛之际，米克尔·阿尔特塔应当警惕亚尔库耶等人带来的威胁。
布莱顿对阵阿森纳，周六下午3点

维塔利·米科连科在本赛季初期的进步在很大程度上没有得到赞誉——在那些批评者眼中可能永远都不会得到——但在大卫·莫耶斯需要经验丰富的球员挺身而出、打破小阵容局限性的时刻，这位埃弗顿左后卫确实做出了贡献。在夏天签下一份为期三年的新合同并且身体似乎更加强壮之后，这位乌克兰国脚用多次令人印象深刻的表现让批评者闭上了嘴，帮助球队在六场比赛中完成了四场零封。在将亚当·阿兹努租借至马拉加一个赛季后，左后卫位置上依然存在令人担忧的替补短缺问题，但防守能力更出色的米科连科已经缓解了新赛季开始前围绕他这个位置的种种担忧。伊普斯维奇的新锋线引援埃默森和齐安·弗莱明将对埃弗顿的防线稳固性构成考验，但如果莫耶斯球队能在漫长的国际比赛日前以一场胜利收官，那么他们将迎来一个令人鼓舞的开局。
埃弗顿对阵伊普斯维奇，周六下午3点

正如热爱直接打法的教练一样，马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒喜欢直奔主题。周四，当被问及鉴于周一晚间在利兹惨遭1-4痛击以及伤病潮的影响，他是否会考虑在周六赫尔城造访泰恩赛德时改打五后卫，或者调整他钟爱的“纵向”战术时，他的回答斩钉截铁。“不，”这位敢于用单字回答问题的教练这样说道。相反，贾伊斯勒期望年轻的球队能够对更宏大的愿景保持信念，因为纽卡斯尔联队在今年夏天签下了八名24岁及以下的球员后，正在适应没有布鲁诺·吉马良斯、桑德罗·托纳利和安东尼·戈 Gordon 的生活。“俱乐部正在经历一段勇敢的旅程，我对此完全致力于此，”这位德国教练说道。“如果遭遇一次挫折，我们不应该抹杀我们的旅程或愿景。我们完全投入，完全一致。我们预料到对阵利兹时的那种情况会发生。我们需要作出回应，但依然要保持信念。我们不会改变。”
纽卡斯尔联对阵赫尔城，周六下午3点

许多人曾对夏天为利亚姆·德拉普支付的4500万英镑转会费冷嘲热讽，但诺丁汉森林似乎是这位前锋找回状态的完美场所。森林此前依靠目前受伤的克里斯·伍德作为进攻箭头取得了巨大成功，而德拉普在某种程度上是这位新西兰前锋的年轻接班人——身体强壮、具有敏锐嗅觉，并且乐于为队友做球。在周六战胜维拉的比赛中，摩根·吉布斯-怀特和德拉普看起来已经产生了默契，两人都渴望在对阵考文垂的比赛中扩大战果，后者在过去两场比赛中已经丢了八球。经历了上赛季紧张的保级战后，森林队似乎重新回到了上升势头，当地议会在周三批准了将城市球场容量从3.1万人扩建至5.25万人、估计耗资7.9亿英镑的计划，这让他们感到非常高兴。
诺丁汉森林对阵考文垂，周六下午5点30分

在远距离观看伯恩茅斯在圣塞巴斯蒂安的欧战首秀——一座安东尼奥·伊劳拉了如指掌的城市后，这位巴斯克主帅将于周日重返他的前东家。伊劳拉曾率领多塞特郡球场杀入欧联杯，创造了队史最佳的第六名成绩，他的教练组助手汤米·埃尔菲克和肖恩·库珀曾效力于伯恩茅斯（前者曾队长身份率领球队在2015年升入英超）。他在南海岸的工作表现为他赢得了执教利物浦的机会，热烈的欢迎是毫无疑问的。尽管樱桃军团在伊劳拉的继任者马尔科·罗泽手下开局慢热，但他们依然会是一个棘手的对手。这位德国教练在6月份正式上任前曾与伊劳拉共处了几个小时，双方都将为这场全方位对抗的比赛做好准备。埃迪·霍恩在执教纽卡斯尔对阵伯恩茅斯的八场联赛中均未能取胜，伊劳拉及其教练团队预计将迎来一场艰苦的考验。
伯恩茅斯对阵利物浦，周日下午2点

周六在埃兰路球场对阵水晶宫时，多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温将肩负重任。丹尼尔·法尔克的中心前锋希望成为自1932年的亚瑟·海德以来，第一位在连续六个主场联赛中都有进球的利兹联球员。教练们常常非常正确地指出，球员比阵型更重要，但就卡尔弗特-勒温而言，法尔克在去年11月下旬改打3-5-2阵型是一个转折点。在此之前，作为单箭头他举步维艰，但一旦与诺亚·奥卡福或卢卡斯·恩梅查搭档，进球便源源不断。当然，利兹联有时会踢3-4-3阵型，或者偶尔回到四后卫，但卡尔弗特-勒温强调了进攻搭档的重要性。在从前四场比赛中拿到8分后，法尔克球队取得了自大卫·奥利里2001-02赛季的班底以来，利兹联在顶级联赛中最出色的开局。这种势头能在水晶宫身上延续吗？海德的纪录会受到威胁吗？3-5-2阵型会是结束更多前锋进球荒的答案吗？
利兹联对阵水晶宫，周日下午2点

曼城在前四场英超联赛中取得全胜拿到12分，其中包括1-0战胜考文垂和曼联、2-1战胜伯恩茅斯以及4-1大胜水晶宫。仅失两球却攻入八球是一个令人印象深刻的纪录，这一数据仅略微逊色于卫冕冠军阿森纳（12个积分中失1球进8球），这似乎是一个美好的预兆，表明恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队本赛季将成为真正的争冠力量。不过，雷吉斯·勒布里斯正密谋终结曼城的不败开局，他可以借鉴上赛季带领桑德兰从足总杯冠军身上拿到平局的经验，尽管那场比赛是在光明球场进行的。在伊蒂哈德球场的对阵中，曼城曾以3-0轻松取胜。
曼城对阵桑德兰，周日下午2点

奥斯卡·鲍勃在周二晚上的伦敦碗球场替补登场对阵西汉姆联，并在比赛尾声阶段用一记冷静的绝杀球将富勒姆送入联赛杯第四轮。这是这位挪威边锋的一次精彩个人表演，但他需要更频繁地展现这种能力。这个进球是鲍勃自今年1月加盟富勒姆以来的首粒进球，以他的能力应该能产出更多的数据。这位23岁的球员是一名聪明的盘带手，在严重的伤病阻碍其发展之前，他看起来已经准备好在曼城站稳脚跟。他的天赋显而易见。鲍勃在世界杯上表现出色，当富勒姆在主场迎战仍在寻求本赛季联赛首胜的曼联时，他应该充满信心。
富勒姆对阵曼联，周日下午4点30分

items.titleEn: Renée: “The reaction has been really good”
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers says she’s seen the response she wanted from her team following last weekend’s 0-0 draw at home to Crystal Palace.
bodyEn: Renée Slegers says she’s seen the response she wanted from her team following last weekend’s 0-0 draw at home to Crystal Palace.

Despite having no trouble creating plenty of chances against the Eagles, we weren’t clinical enough to find the back of the net and so, while that’s naturally been an area to address this week, the head coach says we’ve also been focusing on creating even better chances.

“The best thing is always to get back onto the grass and execute,” she said in her pre-Manchester United press conference on Thursday. “I think psychologically that's good as well for everyone to be able to action things. So we've looked at some things.

“Of course, we were happy with our dominance in the game and our entries in the final third, entries in the box, amount of shots, but we've also been looking at how we can create even bigger opportunities for ourselves when the spaces are really tight and there's a lot of bodies in the box.

“So what are the moments in the game and how do we create spaces? We've applied some ideas, we've reviewed together with the players, we've been on the training page and the players' reaction has been really, really good. They've been working hard in training.”

Not only does Saturday evening’s return to N5 represent the chance to get back to winning ways in front of our supporters, it also provides the opportunity for us to go 20 matches unbeaten for the first time in our Women’s Super League history.

“It’s of course mixed emotions when I hear that stat, it’s very positive that we’re hard to beat and that’s what we feel about ourselves, but also with some recency bias as well of the last game against Crystal Palace where we weren’t able to score that goal, and didn’t get the win,” Renée added. “It’s double, of course we’re proud, but at the same time there are some draws in there like the last one against Palace.

“When I put that with some of the draws we had last year, it’s different for me, if I look at the dominance in the game and expected chances and goals, amount of shots, it’s much higher than what we had last year and we’re on top of things. So it is different, but it’s a draw again.”
Renée was also asked how she’s dealt with the challenge of getting the team to focus on finishing more than chance creation.

“I think there’s always a preparation and psychological challenge, because if you’re in a good place, or you’ve won your last game and been successful, you then have to get everyone ready psychologically for the next challenge,” she said. “You have to get everyone grounded, and in the moment, and that’s no different now.

“But what’s really important for us is we know we can finish, score goals, we know we have a lot of goalscorers in the squad with a lot of quality, so it’s really important the players know that and they feel our trust with that of course. It’s also about the tactical plan, tweaking small things, and hopefully that makes it easier to create more clear-cut chances.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮：“球队的反应非常棒”
items.summaryZh: 雷妮·斯勒格斯表示，在上周末主场战平水晶宫后，球队做出了她所期望的积极反应。
bodyZh: 雷妮·斯勒格斯表示，在上周末主场0比0战平水晶宫后，球队做出了她所期望的积极反应。
尽管我们在对阵水晶宫时创造了大量机会，但我们的终结能力还不够犀利，未能攻破对方球门。因此，这自然成为了本周需要解决的问题，主教练表示我们也一直在专注于创造更好的机会。
她在周四对阵曼联的赛前新闻发布会上表示：“最好的事情总是回到训练场上去执行。我认为从心理上讲，这对每个人来说也是一件好事，能够把事情付诸行动。所以我们已经研究了一些问题。”
“当然，我们对比赛中的统治力、进入对方三十米区域的次数、禁区内的突破以及射门次数感到满意，但我们也一直在研究当空间非常狭小且禁区内人员密集时，我们如何为自己创造更大的机会。”
“那么比赛中的关键时刻是什么，我们如何创造空间？我们应用了一些理念，与球员们一起进行了回顾，我们也走上了训练场，球员们的反应真的非常非常棒。他们在训练中非常努力。”
周六晚上回到主场不仅代表着在球迷面前重回胜利轨道的机会，也为我们提供了在女足英超联赛历史上首次创造20场不败纪录的机会。
雷妮补充道：“当我听到这个数据时，心情自然是复杂的。很难被击败是非常积极的，这也是我们对自己的感觉，但结合最近对阵水晶宫时未能进球且未能取胜的比赛，这种感受也是双重的。当然我们很骄傲，但与此同时其中也有一些平局，比如上一场对阵水晶宫。”
“当我把这与我们去年的一些平局进行对比时，对我来说情况是不同的。如果我看看比赛中的统治力、预期机会和进球数以及射门次数，这比我们去年要高得多，我们掌控了局面。所以情况有所不同，但结果又是一场平局。”
雷妮还被问及她是如何应对如何让球队将注意力集中在终结能力而非创造机会上的挑战的。
她表示：“我认为这始终是一个备战和心理上的挑战，因为如果你处于有利位置，或者赢得了上一场比赛并取得了成功，你随后就必须让每个人在心理上为下一个挑战做好准备。你必须让每个人都脚踏实地、专注当下，现在也没有什么不同。”
“但对我们来说真正重要的是，我们知道我们能够完成终结、进球，我们知道阵容中有很多极具质量的射手，所以让球员们知道这一点非常重要，当然，他们也能感受到我们对他们的信任。这也是关于战术计划的，微调一些小细节，希望这能让创造绝佳机会变得更容易。”

items.summaryEn: By making his Arsenal debut in our Carabao Cup win against Ipswich Town, Theo Julienne has added his name to our roll of honour
bodyEn: By making his Arsenal debut in our Carabao Cup win against Ipswich Town, Theo Julienne has become the latest youngster to benefit from our fine record of handing teenagers opportunities to star in our first team.

The 18-year-old came off the bench at Portman Road to make his first appearance for our men's team, playing alongside four other teenage Hale End products - two-goal hero Max Dowman, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Marli Salmon and Ife Ibrahim, who was making his second appearance after a bow against Kairat Almaty in the Champions League in January.

Theo has become the 932nd player to play for our men's team, and the 21st teenager to receive a debut from Mikel Arteta before turning 20. However, his appearance in the 64th minute ensured that we have continued our record of giving at least one teenager a debut for 31 seasons in a row.

The run began in 1996/97, when Arsene Wenger handed unknown French striker Nicolas Anelka a game against Chelsea in April 1997, before he took the Premier League by storm the following double-winning campaign and netted in the 1998 FA Cup final.

And in the 29 years since, 124 other teenagers have been awarded Gunners debuts. These include Cesc Fabregas, who became our youngest-ever player and goalscorer during the 2003/04 campaign at 16, Invincibles Ashley Cole, Gael Clichy and Jeremie Aliadiere, and Theo Walcott, who netted 108 times in our colours.

Jack Wilshere became our youngest Premier League player when he featured against Blackburn Rovers in 2008, while Bukayo Saka was just 17 when he played against Vorskla Poltava in the Europa League a decade later.

In recent years, our current crop of Young Guns has made plenty of history. Ethan Nwaneri took the title of our youngest player and the first 15-year-old to play in the Premier League against Brentford in 2022, while Jack Porter became our youngest-ever starter when he started against Bolton Wanderers in the Carabao Cup aged 16 years and 72 days in September 2024.

Dowman now holds that record, as well as being the top-flight's youngest-ever goalscorer and title winner, but Salmon is the youngest player to play for us in the Champions League following his debut against Club Brugge in December 2025, aged 16 years and 103 days.
Our youngest debutants

The League Cup has been the biggest testing ground for our players over the past three decades, with 79 of these teenage debutants handed their bows in the competition. 17 have been trusted with Premier League action, while nine have come in the Champions League. Perhaps surprisingly, only seven have come in FA Cup ties.

On six occasions we have blooded four teen debutants in the same game, most recently Porter's bow against Bolton two years ago, when Josh Nichols, Ismael Kabia and Maldini Kaccurri also wore the red and white for the first time. The 2008/09 and 2011/12 campaigns saw the most teenagers debut, with eight apiece.

items.titleZh: 青春梦想：朱利安延续31个赛季的传统
items.summaryZh: 西奥·朱利安完成阿森纳一线队首秀，延续俱乐部传统。
bodyZh: 在联赛杯战胜伊普斯维奇镇的比赛中完成阿森纳一线队首秀后，西奥·朱利安成为了最新一位受益于俱乐部给予青少年球员一线队出场机会优良传统的年轻球员。
这位18岁球员在波特曼路球场替补登场，完成了他代表一线队的首次亮相，与他并肩作战的还有另外四名来自黑尔恩德青训营的青少年球员——独中两元的功臣马克斯·道德曼、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、马利·萨尔蒙，以及在1月份欧冠对阵阿拉木图凯拉特完成首秀后迎来第二次出场的伊费·易卜拉欣。
西奥成为了第932名代表一线队出场的球员，也是阿尔特塔麾下第21位在20岁前上演首秀的青少年球员。然而，他在第64分钟的登场确保了我们连续31个赛季至少为一名青少年球员安排首秀的纪录得以延续。
这一纪录始于1996/97赛季，当时温格在1997年4月对阵切尔西的比赛中派上了名不见经传的法国前锋尼古拉·阿内尔卡，随后阿内尔卡在接下来的双冠王赛季里席卷英超，并在1998年足总杯决赛中破门。
在随后的29年里，还有124名青少年球员上演了阿森纳首秀。其中包括在2003/04赛季以16岁之龄成为我们最年轻出场球员和进球者的采斯·法布雷加斯，“不败之师”成员阿什利·科尔、盖尔·克里希和热雷米·阿利亚迭尔，以及为我们攻入108球的西奥·沃尔科特。
杰克·威尔希尔在2008年对阵布莱克本流浪者的比赛中登场，成为我们最年轻的英超球员；而十年后，布卡约·萨卡在对阵波尔塔瓦沃斯尔塔的欧联杯比赛中出场时年仅17岁。
近年来，我们现有的这批年轻枪手创造了大量历史。伊桑·恩瓦内里在2022年对阵布伦特福德的比赛中夺得了我们最年轻球员以及英超首位15岁出场球员的头衔；而杰克·波特在2024年9月联赛杯对阵博尔顿流浪者的比赛中首发时年仅16岁零72天，成为我们队史最年轻的首发球员。
道德曼现在保持着这一纪录，同时他也是顶级联赛中最年轻的进球者和冠军得主，而萨尔蒙则是我们在欧冠中出场的最年轻球员，他在2025年12月对阵布鲁日的比赛中完成首秀，年仅16岁零103天。
我们最年轻的首秀球员
在过去三十年中，联赛杯一直是锻炼我们球员的最大试验田，这些青少年首秀球员中有79人是在该项赛事中完成首次亮相的。17人获得了英超联赛的出场机会，9人则在欧冠联赛中亮相。令人意外的是，只有7人在足总杯比赛中完成首秀。
我们曾有6次在同一场比赛中安排4名青少年首秀球员，最近的一次是两年前波特在对阵博尔顿的比赛中完成首秀，当时乔什·尼科尔斯、伊斯梅尔·卡比亚和马尔迪尼·卡库里也首次身披红白战袍。2008/09赛季和2011/12赛季是青少年首秀人数最多的赛季，各有8人。

bodyEn: Mikel Merino says Max Dowman reminds him of Lamine Yamal after the Arsenal prodigy continued his development by scoring twice in his side’s 4-2 win against Ipswich.

Dowman, who has been given a host of opportunities at senior level by Mikel Arteta, starred after being handed his first appearance of the season, at Portman Road on Tuesday. The 16-year-old attacker’s classy double eased Arsenal into the last 16 of the Carabao Cup and left Arteta admitting that containing the hype around the England youth international is not an easy task.

Arsenal are managing Dowman carefully and Merino is well placed to see how young talents can benefit from listening to managers and older players. The Arsenal midfielder plays with Lamine Yamal for Spain and believes Dowman is as fearless as the 19-year-old winger.

“There are some similarities in terms of their character,” he said. “They don’t care about the spotlight. They thrive when pressure is at the highest. They are always up for the challenge and they are not shy at all – even facing the biggest names in the game.”

Merino, who also scored against Ipswich, raved about Dowman. “He is an unbelievable talent. We knew it, but every time he goes on the pitch and plays against grown men he makes the difference. He is a big talent and we have to take care of him.

“We have to keep pushing him. He needs to keep learning – eyes and ears open always. There is still big room for improvement in a lot of areas and he knows that. So we are going to be by his side trying to get him to his best level.

“It is a thin line. It is very difficult to have equilibrium sometimes with him, because obviously you want him to shine and show everyone the talent that he has. But you have to sometimes remind them that they are human beings and they are part of a bigger squad and team.

“The good thing with these kind of players – Lamine and Max – is that they are special talents, but at the same time they are very humble. They are always keen to learn and listen to the veterans. That is priceless.”

items.titleZh: 梅里诺：阿森纳新星道曼让我想起了亚马尔
items.summaryZh: 道曼在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中独中两元，梅里诺称赞他是位极具天赋的球员。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳以4-2战胜伊普斯威奇的比赛中，天才小将道曼梅开二度，继续着他的成长轨迹，米克尔·梅里诺表示这让他想起了亚马尔。
道曼在周二的波特曼路球场迎来了本赛季的首次登场并大放异彩，米克尔·阿尔特塔此前已在成年队比赛中给了他许多出场机会。这位16岁攻击手的精彩双响帮助阿森纳轻松晋级联赛杯16强，这也让阿尔特塔承认，控制外界对这位英格兰青年国脚的炒作并非易事。
阿森纳正在谨慎地培养道曼，而梅里诺很清楚年轻才俊如何能从听取教练和老队员的意见中受益。这位阿森纳中场与亚马尔在西班牙国家队并肩作战，他认为道曼和这位19岁的边锋一样无所畏惧。
“他们在性格上有相似之处，”他说。“他们不在乎聚光灯。当压力达到顶峰时，他们反而能茁壮成长。他们总是勇于迎接挑战，而且一点也不害羞——即使面对比赛中最大牌的球星也是如此。”
同样在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中取得进球的梅里诺对道曼赞不绝口。“他是一个不可思议的天才。我们早就知道这一点，但每次他上场与成年人对抗时，他都能改变比赛。他是一个巨大的天才，我们必须照顾好他。”
“我们必须继续推动他。他需要不断学习——时刻保持眼观六路、耳听八方。在许多方面仍有很大的改进空间，他也很清楚这一点。所以我们会站在他身边，努力让他达到最佳水平。”
“这是一条微妙的界限。有时很难在他身上保持平衡，因为你显然希望他发光并向所有人展示他的天赋。但你有时必须提醒他们，他们是人类，他们是一个更大的阵容和团队的一部分。”
“这类球员的好处——无论是亚马尔还是马克思（道曼），他们都是特殊的天才，但与此同时他们也非常谦逊。他们总是热衷于学习并倾听老将们的教诲。这是无价的。”

梅里诺还称赞了马尔利·萨尔蒙，这位17岁小将在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中表现亮眼。“在那个中后卫的位置上，你需要非常成熟，”他说。

items.titleEn: Ipswich Town 2-4 Arsenal: Carabao Cup third round – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Max Dowman struck twice as the Gunners eased past the hosts to advance to the fourth roundAllan Castle writes in:As a British-born Canadian, who has shuttled back and forth over the Atlantic for six decades, when I get back to England I seek out cherished beverages past and present that are unavailable or only sporadically found in Canada: orange squash, ginger beer, Theakston’s Old Peculier, real bitter, etc. What is Carabao? What does it taste like? And, perhaps most important, what are the cultural assumptions British people make about Carabao drinkers? I’m old enough to know that no seemingly benign refreshment decision in the UK is made without social consequences.With Enciso on the bench, Arsenal will win. It’s too bad for Ipswich’s lack of courage. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Ed Aarons reports from Portman Road, with plenty of praise for Arsenal’s youngsters. That’s all from me. Thanks for reading!
A very happy night for Arsenal fans.
It goes down as Max Dowman’s night. Noni Madueke was dangerous, too, skipping down the right, and Ipswich never really threatened to do something special.
Arteta’s men progress. A tidy night, even with those two Ipswich goals in the second half.
Davis sends in a low cross from the left, Akpom collects, turns and shoots, and adds some respectability to the scoreline.
A goal against his former club!
90 min: Just two extra minutes added on.
88 min: Alan Baverstock writes in.
double quotation markDowman is definitely in the England team for the next World Cup isn’t he? Who else from the next generation?
He’ll be 20 – ancient – at the next World Cup.
87 min: Salmon intercepts by the halfway line and is taken down by Núñez, who goes in the book.
85 min: Ife Ibrahim is on for Arsenal, replacing Zubimendi. Ødegaard sends in a corner, punched by Walton.
84 min: Arsenal give the possession stats a boost.
81 min: There’s a handball shout inside the Arsenal area … but the ref blows for offside.
80 min: The game turns end-to-end, with Walton saving from Tzolis before Clarke very nearly has a chance to shoot for Ipswich.
77 min: Ipswich only started to play in the first half after going 2-0 down. It’s been a similar story this half, two more conceded before rediscovering some intensity.
76 min: Eze and the impressive Madueke go off. Ødegaard and Tzolis come on.
74 min: Gyökeres’ difficult game continues, unable to take control of the ball as Arsenal break … Ipswich respond with a shot on target, Arrizabalaga getting low to his right to hold on.
73 min: Eze twists and turns on the left and tries a cross/shot that travels wide.
72 min: Julienne overcooks a ball directed towards Lewis-Skelly, who drifts inside the area.
70 min: Leif Davis is on for Ipswich … and he whips in a delicious cross from the left. Arrizabalaga does well to collect cleanly.
68 min: Akpom, who started his career at Arsenal, finds the sidenetting with a cross.
65 min: Theo Julienne, 18 years old, is on for Guimarães.

Clarke, replacing Philogene on the left for Ipswich, drives down the wing and cuts back for Mehmeti, who finds the bottom corner to give Ipswich fans something to shout about. Or to set up the greatest comeback in Carabao history.
Instant impact from Clarke!
61 min: Ipswich make changes, with Chuba Akpom and Jack Clarke sent on.
Merino collects on the edge of the area and has enough space to curl in with his left foot. Clinical.
And another.
57 min: Arsenal continue to dominate the ball.

54 min: The corner is worked short … and the ball eventually finds Madueke inside the area, an excellent first touch setting him up for an effort … he pokes it across goal instead, perhaps hoping to find Gyökeres, but it escapes the centre-forward.
53 min: Madueke takes on Ouattara, who times his challenge well, leading to an Arsenal corner.
52 min: Arsenal knock it around at the back.
50 min: Flemming fights for the ball out on Ipswich’s left, gets a decent cross in … but he needs to be in the middle, too. Arrizabalaga collects.

Madueke pokes the ball through to Zubimendi inside the area, and he finds Dowman on the right-hand side. He calmly slots in once again – there’s a shout for an Ipswich handball in there, but the 16-year-old’s finish makes it irrelevant.
That’ll wrap it up.
46 min: We go again, with Arsenal on the ball and Lewis-Skelly drifting from left-back into midfield.
A change from Arsenal: Ezri Konsa replaces Gabriel.
Arsenal have had moments where they’ve been a bit open, particularly down the Ipswich left, where Zubimendi is filling in. But Gabriel has been typically solid, nipping in to sort any issues.
Kári Tulinius writes in:
double quotation markThe way Max Dowman cut through the Ipswich defense it was as if he was a 26-year-old playing against 16-year-olds.
A fairly smooth half for the Premier League champions.
45 min: We’ll have an extra minute.
43 min: Ipswich have been much better since going two-down but … well, they’re two-down.
41 min: Guimarães very nearly sneaks a ball to Eze inside the area, but it’s cut out by a blue shirt.
40 min: Mehmeti finds the ball on the left for Ipswich as they break, just Gabriel ahead of him … but it’s Gabriel. He doesn’t dive in, keeping Mehmeti quiet while Arsenal retreat.
37 min: Philogene, on Ipswich’s left, goes around the outside, into the area, leaving Salmon on the floor … but Arrizabalaga gets in the way of his cutback.
36 min: Gyökeres has had a quiet half.
35 min: Eze cuts in from the left … and has his shot blocked.
34 min: Merino gives away the ball in midfield and Ipswich win a corner … Núñez sends it into the front post, it’s flicked into a dangerous area … but Gabriel, once again, is there to save Arsenal.
32 min: Salmon slips up for Arsenal and Ipswich break forward … but Gabriel, the senior man at the back, slides in to clean up inside his area.

items.titleZh: 伊普斯维奇 2-4 阿森纳：联赛杯第三轮比赛实录
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·道曼梅开二度，阿森纳轻取对手晋级第四轮。
bodyZh: 埃德·阿隆斯从波特曼路球场发回报道，并对阿森纳的年轻球员们赞不绝口。我的播报就到这里，感谢阅读！
对于阿森纳球迷来说这是一个非常快乐的夜晚。
这个夜晚属于马克斯·道曼。马杜埃凯在右路的突破也极具威胁，伊普斯维奇从未真正构成实质威胁。
阿尔特塔的球队晋级了。这是一场轻松的比赛，尽管下半场丢了两个球。
戴维斯从左路送出低平球传中，阿克蓬接球转身射门，为球队挽回了一些颜面。
攻破老东家球门！
第90分钟：仅补时两分钟。
第88分钟：阿兰·巴弗斯特罗姆来信称。
道曼肯定能入选下一届世界杯的英格兰队吧？还有哪位是下一代新星？
到下一届世界杯时他才20岁——还很年轻。
第87分钟：萨尔蒙在半场附近拦截，被努涅斯犯规放倒，后者吃到黄牌。
第85分钟：伊费·易卜拉欣替补登场为阿森纳出场，换下祖比门迪。厄德高罚出角球，沃尔顿将球击出。
第84分钟：阿森纳进一步提升了控球率数据。
第81分钟：阿森纳禁区内疑似有手球……但裁判吹越位在先。
第80分钟：比赛进入对攻战，沃尔顿扑出了齐奥利斯的射门，随后克拉克险些为伊普斯维奇获得射门机会。
第77分钟：伊普斯维奇在上半场落后两球后才开始进入状态。下半场也是如此，在找回强度之前又丢了两球。
第76分钟：埃泽和表现出色的马杜埃凯离场。厄德高和齐奥利斯替补登场。
第74分钟：哲凯赖什表现艰难，在阿森纳反击时无法控制住球……伊普斯维奇随后回敬一脚射门，阿里萨巴拉加倒地将球按在身下。
第73分钟：埃泽在左路连续盘带后尝试传中兼射门，皮球偏出。
第72分钟：于连传球过大，未能给到插向禁区内的刘易斯-斯凯利。
第70分钟：利夫·戴维斯替补登场为伊普斯维奇出战……他从左路送出一脚精妙传中。阿里萨巴拉加稳稳将球摘下。
第68分钟：职业生涯出道于阿森纳的阿克蓬传中击中边网。
第65分钟：18岁的特奥·于连替补登场换下吉马良斯。
替补登场的克拉克在伊普斯维奇左路突破吉马良斯后横传，梅梅蒂推射远角得手，为主场球迷带来了欢呼的理由，也为他们保留了创造联赛杯历史最大翻盘的希望。
克拉克替补登场即建功！
第61分钟：伊普斯维奇进行换人调整，丘巴·阿克蓬和杰克·克拉克替补登场。
梅里诺在禁区边缘得球，获得足够的空间后用左脚兜射破门。极其冷酷。
再进一球。
第57分钟：阿森纳继续掌控球权。
第54分钟：角球短传配合……皮球最终传到禁区内的马杜埃凯脚下，他极佳的第一触球调整好步点……但他没有选择射门，而是将球横扫门前，或许是希望找到哲凯赖什，但球滑门而过。
第53分钟：马杜埃凯对位瓦塔拉，后者防守时机掌握得很好，为阿森纳赢得一个角球。
第52分钟：阿森纳在后场倒脚。
第50分钟：弗莱明在伊普斯维奇左路拼抢得球，送出一脚不错的传中……但他自己也需要赶到中路接应。阿里萨巴拉加将球没收。
马杜埃凯将球捅给禁区内的祖比门迪，后者顺势分给右路的道曼。他从容冷静地再次推射破门——虽然伊普斯维奇球员投诉有手球嫌疑，但这名16岁小将的射门让这一切变得不再重要。
这球锁定了胜局。
第46分钟：下半场比赛开始，阿森纳控球，刘易斯-斯凯利从左后卫位置游弋到中场。
阿森纳做出换人调整：埃兹里·孔萨替换加布里埃尔。
阿森纳有过防守空虚的时刻，特别是在伊普斯维奇的左路，祖比门迪在那里补防。但加布里埃尔一如既往地稳健，及时上抢化解了险情。
卡里·图利尼乌斯来信称：
马森·道曼切入伊普斯维奇防线的方式，就像是一个26岁的成年人在踢16岁小孩。
对于英超冠军来说，这是一个相当顺利的上半场。
第45分钟：上半场将补时一分钟。
第43分钟：伊普斯维奇在两球落后之后表现好了很多，但……毕竟他们已经落后两球了。
第41分钟：吉马良斯险些将球塞给禁区内的埃泽，但被身穿蓝衣的防守球员截断。
第40分钟：梅梅蒂在伊普斯维奇反击中在左路得球，前方只有加布里埃尔……但他可是加布里埃尔。他没有贸然上抢，而是压制住梅梅蒂的突破，同时等待阿森纳全队回防。
第37分钟：伊普斯维奇左路的菲洛根内带球内切杀入禁区，晃倒了萨尔蒙……但阿里萨巴拉加封堵了对方的倒三角回传。
第36分钟：哲凯赖什在上半场存在感不强。
第35分钟：埃泽从左路内切……但射门被封堵。
第34分钟：梅里诺在中场丢球，伊普斯维奇赢得角球……努涅斯将球传向近门柱，皮球被蹭到危险区域……但加布里埃尔再次挺身而出拯救了阿森纳。
第32分钟：萨尔蒙防守失误导致阿森纳防线被反击突破……但后防老将加布里埃尔滑铲将禁区内的险情化解。

bodyEn: The bad news for everyone else is that Arsenal’s next generation is already here. Two mesmerising goals and an assist in a man-of-the-match display from Max Dowman underlined why the 16-year-old has been compared to a certain Lionel Messi by his manager, Mikel Arteta, as Ipswich were swatted aside with ease. Almost as impressive was the performance of the 17-year-old Marli Salmon, who oozed class in central defence on only the second senior start of his career.

Ipswich won here the last time these two sides met in this competition, in 2011, but were beaten 3-0 in the second leg of the semi-final at the Emirates before Arsenal infam­ously lost to Birmingham in the final. ­Fifteen years on, Gary O’Neil’s heavily rotated side stood no chance against last year’s runners up after Dowman’s brilliant opening goal. Noni Madueke and the stand-in skipper Mikel Merino were also on target as Arsenal made it seven wins out of seven to start the new campaign. Having finally ended their long wait for silverware in style, this team are hungry for more and know they can now rely on one of the most exciting talents ever to have emerged from their Hale End academy.

“He can deliver those actions effortlessly. That’s his biggest quality,” said Arteta of the delightful shimmy that preceded Dowman’s first goal. “It’s a joy to have him. But what we have to do is look after him. He’s 16 years old, you don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context. We really need to make sure every time we throw him in, he’s in the right context with the right ­preparation. That’s what we are ­trying to do.”

Both managers made their prior­ities clear as there were a combined 19 changes from their sides’ wins in the Premier League at the weekend. After a summer of heavy spending, many of those who helped Ipswich bounce straight back from the Championship last season were given an opportunity to stake a claim but largely failed to do so. “It’s the most extreme test that you can face,” admitted O’Neil. “Every time we made a mistake we were punished.”

Dowman’s most recent first-team appearance was in the final game of last season when Arsenal were crowned champions, and he has since completed his GCSEs before spending a week in New York during the World Cup where he rubbed shoulders with Paul Pogba.

Arteta said beforehand he would have “earn his minutes” like anyone else and it only took seven of them for Dowman to seize his opportunity. Ipswich’s fans were taunting their Arsenal counterparts about never being crowned European champions when he muscled Santiago Núñez off the ball on the halfway line and set off towards the penalty area. The imposing figure of Cédric Kipré – all 6ft 3in of him – was all that stood in Dowman’s way but he went past the Ivory Coast defender in a flurry of feet before cooly dispatching a shot into the corner and performing a Thierry Henry knee slide for good measure.

Peterborough moved into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup for the first time since 2009 thanks to a 7-6 penalty shootout victory over Barnsley that followed a thrilling 3-3 draw between the two League One sides.

Barnsley were handed the lead after 61 seconds when a clearance by the Peterborough goalkeeper, Alex Bass, was charged down by Cameron McGeehan, with the Tykes captain nodding in after the ball had come off the bar.
Peterborough equalised in the 19th minute when Lucca Mendonca’s cross was pushed out by the Barnsley goalkeeper, Kieran Flavell, as far as Harry Leonard, who prodded in.

The hosts then completed the turnaround after 27 minutes when Harley Mills’ free-kick was headed in by the unmarked Danny Ormerod. But the Tykes were level five minutes before half-time when Reyes Cleary beat Mendonca with ease down the left before placing his shot into the bottom corner.
The visitors looked to have won it when Cleary bent in his second in the 74th minute, but Ormerod sent the tie to penalties with by heading in Mills’ cross with just two minutes remaining.
After 12 successful spot-kicks, a tame effort from Barnsley’s Luke Alker was saved by Bass, giving Harrison Jones the chance to send the hosts through, which he dispatched.

Brentford emerged from a tense finish against Reading to book their place in the Carabao Cup fourth round with a 2-1 victory. Callum Wilson and Fabio Carvalho were on target in the first half as the Premier League club showed a clinical touch against League One opposition, who produced a number of chances but lacked the firepower to finish them off. Paudie O’Connor eventually pulled one back to revive Reading’s challenge and Brentford could not rest easy in the remaining 18 minutes, although the substitute Igor Thiago was among those who should have killed the match off. Press Association

Ipswich’s mission got even harder when Madueke hammered in after Bruno Guimarães and Merino had combined to set him up after Dowman had started the press. Barely a quarter of an hour had been played. To their credit, the hosts rallied and it needed a clearance off the line from Salmon to deny Zian Flemming. Not to be outdone by Dowman, Salmon – who signed his professional contact when he turned 17 last month having also played in the Champions League and FA Cup last season – set out on a slaloming run just before half-time after calmly turning his way out of trouble under pressure from Flemming, drawing a round of applause from the Arsenal bench.

Ipswich’s hopes of mounting a comeback were extinguished within two minutes of the restart when Dowman struck again. Martín Zubimendi’s pass found him on the edge of the six-yard box and the finish was caressed into the far corner. Merino then curled home off the post from Dowman’s touch to put the result beyond any doubt, although the biggest roar of the evening came when Ipswich hit back through Anis Mehmeti after he was set up by the substitute Jack Clarke.

Including Myles Lewis-Skelly – a relative veteran these days at 19 and surely in line for an England recall this week after an excellent start to the season – Arsenal had four teenagers on the pitch at the end after the 18-year-old Theo Julienne came on at right-back. Even Ipswich had a Hale End grad­uate in their ranks by then as Chuba Akpom grabbed another consolation in injury time via a deflection. But, not for the last time one suspects, it was Dowman’s name that was on everyone’s lips at the end.

items.titleZh: 麦克斯·道曼独中两元助阿森纳替补阵容在联赛杯中击败伊普斯维奇
items.summaryZh: 16岁的道曼在联赛杯中奉献两球一助攻，帮助阿森纳轻松击败伊普斯维奇晋级。
bodyZh: 对其他人来说，坏消息是阿森纳的新生代已经到来。16岁的麦克斯·道曼在比赛中上演了全场最佳表现，奉献了两粒精彩的进球和一次助攻，这也印证了为什么主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔将这位年轻人与某位莱昂内尔·梅西相提并论，伊普斯维奇最终被轻松轻取。同样令人印象深刻的是17岁球员马利·萨尔蒙的表现，他在职业生涯仅有的第二次一线队首发出场中，在中央防守位置上展现出了极高的水准。

这两支球队上一次在该项赛事中相遇是在2011年，当时伊普斯维奇在这里取胜，但在酋长球场的半决赛次回合中以0比3失利，随后阿森纳在决赛中遗憾不敌伯明翰。十五年后，加里·奥尼尔大幅轮换的阵容在面对去年的亚军时毫无胜算，道曼打入了精彩的远射首开纪录。诺尼·马杜埃凯和代理队长米克尔·梅里诺也分别建功，阿森纳在新赛季开局取得了七连胜。在终于如愿以偿结束了长时间的冠军荒后，这支球队对更多荣誉充满渴望，并且深知他们现在可以依仗青训营中涌现出的最令人兴奋的天才之一。
“他能够毫不费力地完成这些动作。这是他最大的特点，”阿尔特塔谈到道曼第一球前那次精彩的晃动时说道。“拥有他是种快乐。但我们要做的就是保护他。他只有16岁，你在英超联赛中看不到这样的情况。在欧洲其他联赛，那是完全不同的环境。我们真的需要确保每次派他上场时，他都处于正确的环境并做好了充分的准备。这正是我们努力在做的。”
双方主教练都明确了各自的优先级，因为两队在周末英超联赛取胜的基础上总共作出了19处人员调整。经过一个夏天的巨额引援，许多帮助伊普斯维奇在上赛季直接从英冠升级的球员得到了证明自己的机会，但大多未能把握住。“这是你可能面临的最极端考验，”奥尼尔承认道。“我们每一次犯错都受到了惩罚。”
道曼上一次代表一线队出场是在上赛季阿森纳加冕冠军的最后一轮比赛中，自那以后他完成了普通中等教育证书考试（GCSEs），随后在世界杯期间前往纽约度过了一周，在那里与保罗·博格巴有过接触。
阿尔特塔赛前表示，他需要像其他人一样“挣得出场时间”，而道曼只用了七分钟就抓住了机会。当他在中场线从圣地亚哥·努涅斯脚下抢断并向禁区挺进时，伊普斯维奇球迷还在嘲笑阿森纳从未加冕欧洲冠军。身材高大的塞德里克·基普雷身高6英尺3英寸，是他面前唯一的障碍，但道曼在一阵眼花缭乱的脚法中晃过了这位科特迪瓦后卫，随后冷静地将球送入死角，并顺势模仿蒂埃里·亨利来了一次滑跪庆祝。
皮特堡联队凭借在点球大战中7比6战胜巴恩斯利，自2009年以来首次闯入联赛杯第四轮，此前两支英甲球队在常规时间战成3比3平。
巴恩斯利在比赛开始61秒后取得领先，当时皮特堡联队门将亚历克斯·巴斯的解围被卡梅伦·麦吉汉挡出，皮球击中横梁后由泰克斯队队长头球补射破门。
皮特堡联队在第19分钟扳平比分，卢卡·门多萨的传中被巴恩斯利门将基兰·弗拉维尔扑出，哈里·莱昂纳德补射得手。
主队随后在第27分钟完成反超，哈利·米尔斯的任意球被无人盯防的丹尼·奥尔默罗头球顶进。但客队在半场结束前五分钟将比分扳平，雷耶斯·克利里在左路轻松过掉门多萨后将球射入底角。
当克利里在第74分钟兜射攻入个人第二球时，客队看似已经锁定胜局，但奥尔默罗在比赛还剩两分钟时接米尔斯传中头球破门，将比赛拖入点球大战。
在12次成功的点球之后，巴恩斯利球员卢克·阿尔克的绵软射门被巴斯扑出，给了哈里森·琼斯为主队罚进制胜点球的机会，他稳稳罚中。
布伦特福德在与雷丁的紧张对决中以2比1取胜，锁定了联赛杯第四轮的席位。卡勒姆·威尔逊和法比奥·卡瓦略在上半场建功，展现了这支英超球队面对英甲对手时的门前效率，客队虽然创造了不少机会但缺乏终结能力。保迪·奥康纳随后为雷丁扳回一城重燃希望，布伦特福德在剩下的18分钟里不敢松懈，尽管替补出场的伊戈尔·蒂亚戈本有机会杀死比赛悬念。美联社
伊普斯维奇的任务变得更加艰巨，在道曼发动前场逼抢后，布鲁诺·吉马良斯和梅里诺联手助攻马杜埃凯轰门得手。当时比赛才进行了刚刚过一刻钟。值得赞赏的是，主队随后发起反扑，萨尔蒙门线解围挡出了齐安·弗莱明的射门。萨尔蒙上个月年满17岁时签署了职业合同，上赛季还在欧冠和足总杯中有过登场，他不甘示弱，在半场结束前面对弗莱明的紧逼冷静摆脱困境后开始了一次长途奔袭，赢得了阿森纳替补席的一片掌声。

伊普斯维奇逆转的希望在下半场开始两分钟后彻底破灭，当时道曼再次破门。马丁·祖比门迪的传球找到了小禁区边缘的他，他将球轻巧地推入远角。随后梅里诺接道曼的传球在门柱边兜射破门，彻底锁定了胜局，不过全场最大的欢呼声来自于伊普斯维奇由替补出场的杰克·克拉克助攻阿尼斯·穆罕默迪扳回一城时。
算上迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利——如今19岁的他已算是一名“老将”，且凭借出色的赛季开局本周有望重新入选英格兰代表团——阿森纳在比赛结束时场上有四名青少年球员，此前18岁的特奥·于利安替补登场司职右后卫。甚至连伊普斯维奇阵中当时也有了一位黑尔恩德青训毕业生，丘巴·阿克庞在补时阶段通过折射打入了一粒安慰奖性质的进球。不过，人们在终场时议论纷纷的名字依然是道曼，这恐怕不会是最后一次。

bodyEn: On the podcast today: Max Rushden is joined by Barry Glendenning, Barney Ronay, and John Brewin to round up the weekend’s Premier League action.

Manchester City beat Manchester United at Old Trafford with a controversial Erling Haaland goal. Has the job of referees become too difficult for regular folk, and do we need Nasa scientists or data wonks instead at Pro Ref?

Elsewhere, Arsenal beat Sunderland in spite of a debatable decision of their own, there are more goals at both ends at Stamford Bridge, absolutely no goals in sight for Spurs, and another goal of the season contender from an unlikely source.
Plus, there’s trouble at Aston Villa, another draw for Bournemouth and a discussion about the lost art of grappling.

items.summaryZh: 最新一期足球周报播客讨论了英超周末焦点战及裁判争议。
bodyZh: 在今天的播客节目中：马克斯·拉什登（Max Rushden）携手巴里·格伦登宁（Barry Glendenning）、巴尼·罗奈（Barney Ronay）以及约翰·布鲁因（John Brewin）共同总结了周末的英超联赛战况。
曼城凭借埃尔林·哈兰德（Erling Haaland）一个充满争议的进球在老特拉福德击败了曼联。裁判的工作对普通人来说是不是变得太难了？我们是不是需要美国宇航局的科学家或者数据专家来取代职业比赛裁判公司（Pro Ref）？
在其他场次中，阿森纳在也遭遇了一次可疑判罚的情况下击败了桑德兰；斯坦福桥迎来了更多进球；热刺则完全看不到进球的希望；此外，还有一位意想不到的球员打入了又一个赛季最佳进球的候选。
此外，阿斯顿维拉遇到了麻烦，伯恩茅斯再次收获平局，节目还讨论了渐渐失传的缠斗艺术。

bodyEn: Arsenal are seeking an explanation from Pro Ref over the penalty awarded to Sunderland on Saturday, which Mikel Arteta described as “unacceptable at this level”. It is understood the Premier League champions contacted Pro Ref on Monday to request a meeting after Ezri Konsa was penalised during an incident involving Dan Ballard at the Stadium of Light.
David Raya made a brilliant save to deny Enzo Le Fée’s spot-kick before Arsenal went on to win 2-0.

Arteta could not hide his anger afterwards, and other Arsenal officials are said to have been left annoyed by the penalty decision. Arsenal are expected to question why the video assistant referee did not intervene when the referee, John Brooks, pointed to the spot.

They are also likely to bring up the fact that the Premier League’s key match incidents (KMI) panel unanimously ruled the club should have been awarded a penalty in their win at Aston Villa last month when Bruno Guimarães was fouled by Ian Maatsen.

The KMI panel ruled last season that Gabriel Magalhães should have been shown a red card for violent conduct against Manchester City in April that would have ruled the Brazil defender out for three matches in the title run-in.

Arteta said the decision against Sunderland “could have cost us the win and our momentum” after a 100% start and Arsenal’s fear is that refereeing mistakes and inconsistencies could end up deciding the title race.

They, like other Premier League clubs, are in regular dialogue with Pro Ref and are expected to ask for clarification on whether similar incidents to the one involving Konsa and Ballard from a corner will result in more penalties being given.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳要求就对阵桑德兰时的点球判罚与职业裁判公司会面
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳要求职业裁判公司就对阵桑德兰的点球判罚给出解释。
bodyZh: 阿森纳正就周六对阵桑德兰时被判罚的点球向职业裁判公司寻求解释，米克尔·阿尔特塔将该判罚形容为“在这一水平上不可接受”。据了解，这家英超俱乐部已于周一联系职业裁判公司要求会面，此前埃兹里·孔萨在光明球场与丹·巴拉德的冲突中被判犯规。
大卫·拉亚做出了一次精彩扑救，挡出了恩佐·勒费埃主罚的点球，随后阿森纳以2比0取胜。
阿尔特塔赛后无法掩饰他的愤怒，据说其他阿森纳官员也对这次点球判罚感到不满。预计阿森纳将质疑为什么当主裁判约翰·布鲁克斯指向点球点时，视频助理裁判没有介入。
他们还可能会提及这样一个事实：英超关键比赛判罚小组上个月一致裁定，在上个月客场击败阿斯顿维拉的比赛中，当布鲁诺·吉马良斯对伊恩·马特森犯规时，俱乐部本应获得一个点球。
关键比赛判罚小组上赛季曾裁定，加布里埃尔·马加良斯在4月对阵曼城的比赛中因暴力行为本应吃到红牌，这将导致这名巴西后卫在争冠冲刺阶段缺席三场比赛。
阿尔特塔表示，针对桑德兰的这一判罚“本可能让我们失去胜利和势头”，此前球队取得了百分之百的开局，阿森纳担心裁判的失误和判罚不一致最终可能会决定争冠走势。
他们与其他英超俱乐部一样，与职业裁判公司保持着定期对话，预计将要求澄清：涉及孔萨和巴拉德在角球防守中的类似事件是否会导致更多的点球判罚。
